rows.s_sql:
SET	@prov_c := '%s';
SET @id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP  TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_iodine_w;
CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_iodine_w(
g_date_serv text,
vq1 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
vq2 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
vq3 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
vq4 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
g_date_did text,
g_code text,
rq1 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
rq2 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
rq3 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
rq4 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid),
KEY (hospcode,pid),
KEY (cid)
) ENGINE=myisam IGNORE AS
SELECT a.hospcode,a.pid,a.cid,a.gravida,a.ancplace
,GROUP_CONCAT(a.date_serv ORDER BY a.date_serv) as g_date_serv
,0 as vq1,0 as vq2,0 as vq3,0 as vq4
,null as  g_date_did,null as g_code
,0 as rq1,0 as rq2,0 as rq3,0 as rq4
FROM	t_person_db p1 
							INNER JOIN  tmp_anc a ON p1.HOSPCODE=a.HOSPCODE AND p1.PID=a.PID
									AND  a.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  AND a.HOSPCODE=a.ANCPLACE 
WHERE p1.DISCHARGE='9'  AND p1.nation in(99)
GROUP BY hospcode,pid;

UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET vq1=1 WHERE g_date_serv REGEXP '(-10-|-11-|-12-)';
UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET vq2=1 WHERE g_date_serv REGEXP '(-01-|-02-|-03-)';
UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET vq3=1 WHERE g_date_serv REGEXP '(-04-|-05-|-06-)';
UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET vq4=1 WHERE g_date_serv REGEXP '(-07-|-08-|-09-)';

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_drug_iodine_w;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_drug_iodine_w(
PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid),
KEY (hospcode,pid)
) ENGINE=myisam IGNORE AS
SELECT hospcode,pid
							,GROUP_CONCAT(date_serv ORDER BY date_serv) g_date_did
							,GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('{"DATE_SERV":"',date_serv,'","DIDSTD":"',didstd
								,'","DNAME":"',dname,'","AMOUNT":"',amount,'"}'	) ORDER BY date_serv) g_code
FROM tmp_drug_opd 
WHERE  DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
									AND SUBSTR(DIDSTD,1,19) in(
									'2011203200377262217','2011101000199999203','1011100000030821217'
									,'2011101000199999203','2011101000199999218','2020301200199999203'
									) AND amount >0
GROUP BY hospcode,pid;

UPDATE tmp_iodine_w t INNER JOIN tmp_drug_iodine_w d ON t.hospcode=d.hospcode AND t.pid=d.pid
SET t.g_date_did=d.g_date_did ,t.g_code=d.g_code;

UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET rq1=1 WHERE g_date_did REGEXP '(-10-|-11-|-12-)' AND vq1 IN(1);
UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET rq2=1 WHERE g_date_did REGEXP '(-01-|-02-|-03-)' AND vq2 IN(1);
UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET rq3=1 WHERE g_date_did REGEXP '(-04-|-05-|-06-)' AND vq3 IN(1);
UPDATE tmp_iodine_w SET rq4=1 WHERE g_date_did REGEXP '(-07-|-08-|-09-)' AND vq4 IN(1);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_anc_iodine(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result2 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result3 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target4 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
 result4 int(7) DEFAULT 0,

	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_kpi_anc_iodine WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_anc_iodine
(
SELECT @id,a.HOSPCODE,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
			,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID)) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.rq1 in(1) OR a.rq2 in(1) OR a.rq3 in(1) OR a.rq4 in(1) 
			, CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) result
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq1 in(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) tg1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq1 in(1) AND a.rq1 IN(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) rq1

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq2 in(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) tg2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq2 in(1) AND a.rq2 IN(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) rq2

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq3 in(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) tg3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq3 in(1) AND a.rq3 IN(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) rq3

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq4 in(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) tg4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.vq4 in(1) AND a.rq4 IN(1) , CONCAT(a.HOSPCODE,'-',a.PID),NULL )) rq4

FROM	t_person_db p1 
							INNER JOIN  tmp_iodine_w a ON p1.HOSPCODE=a.HOSPCODE AND p1.PID=a.PID
							INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode 
WHERE p1.DISCHARGE='9'  AND p1.nation in(99) 
GROUP BY hoscode
);

rows.bname: จำนวนหญิงตั้งครรภ์ที่มารับบริการ
rows.notice:
เป้าหมาย คือ หญิงตั้งครรภ์ที่มารับบริการในปีงบประมาณ นับเป็นคนต่อสถานบริการต่อปี และคนต่อสถานบริการต่อไตรมาส
-คนต่อสถานบริการต่อปี หมายถึง หญิงตั้งครรภ์ 1 คน มารับบริการหลายครั้งในปี นับเป้าหมายคือ 1 คน
-คนต่อสถานบริการต่อไตรมาส หมายถึง หญิงตั้งครรภ์ 1 คน มารับบริการหลายครั้งไตรมาส นับเป้าหมายไตรมาสละ 1 คน

ผลงาน คือ หญิงตั้งครรภ์ที่มารับบริการในปีงบประมาณ และได้รับยาเม็ดเสริมไอโอดีน ธาตุเหล็ก และกรดโฟลิก และบันทึกรหัสยา 24 หลักตาม สำนักโภชนาการกำหนด โดย 19 หลักแรกเป็น
1. Triferdine 150 = 201120320037726221781506
2. Obimin-az = 201110100019999920381199
3. Iodine Gpo = 101110000003082121781506
4. Nataral = 201110100019999920381341
5. Nataral EF = 201110100019999921881341
6. Prenamed = 202030120019999920381252
rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c:=(SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1); SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1); SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001'); SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930'); DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx( SELECT h.hoscode as hospcode, p1.PRENAME,p1.PID, p1.CID,hosname,p1.NAME, p1.LNAME, p1.SEX, p1.BIRTH ,p1.HID, p1.addr, p1.check_vhid, p1.NATION, p1.TYPEAREA ,g_date_serv ,IF(vq1 in(1),'มารับบริการ',null) as vq1 ,IF(vq2 in(1),'มารับบริการ',null) as vq2 ,IF(vq3 in(1),'มารับบริการ',null) as vq3 ,IF(vq4 in(1),'มารับบริการ',null) as vq4 ,REPLACE(g_code,'},{','}
,{') g_code ,IF(rq1 in(1),'ได้รับยา',null) as rq1 ,IF(rq2 in(1),'ได้รับยา',null) as rq2 ,IF(rq3 in(1),'ได้รับยา',null) as rq3 ,IF(rq4 in(1),'ได้รับยา',null) as rq4 ,IF(rq1 in(1) OR rq2 in(1) OR rq3 in(1) OR rq4 in(1) ,'ได้รับ ','ไม่ได้รับ' ) result FROM t_person_db p1 INNER JOIN tmp_iodine_w a ON p1.HOSPCODE=a.HOSPCODE AND p1.PID=a.PID INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode WHERE p1.DISCHARGE='9' AND p1.nation in(99) GROUP BY p1.HOSPCODE,p1.PID ); SELECT h.hoscode ,h.hosname,d.PID, d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME, d.SEX, d.BIRTH ,d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA ,d.g_date_serv,d.vq1,d.vq2,d.vq3,d.vq4 ,d.g_code,d.rq1,d.rq2,d.rq3,d.rq4 ,d.result FROM tx d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("target1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("result1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("target2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("result2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("target3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("result3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("target4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("result4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT h.chw_code as a_code,h.chw_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("target1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("result1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("target2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("result2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("target3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("result3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("target4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("result4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.chw_code, h.chw_name ORDER BY h.chw_code

moo.label: หมู่
moo.query: SELECT s.areacode as a_code ,CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 7 THEN SUBSTRING(s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 1) WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 8 THEN SUBSTRING(s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 2) ELSE 'ไม่ระบุ' END AS a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("target1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("result1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("target2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("result2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("target3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("result3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("target4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("result4") as "resultq4" FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY s.areacode ORDER BY s.areacode

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name , SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("target1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("result1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("target2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("result2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("target3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("result3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("target4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("result4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hostype IN('05','06','07','11','12','15') AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.hoscode, h.hosname ORDER BY h.hoscode
